in_marathi.name: Saikh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sage or Saint
in_marathi.long_meaning: Saikh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is wise, virtuous, and has gained spiritual knowledge and understanding through deep meditation and contemplation. Often revered as a sage or saint in Hindu society.

in_bengali.name: Saikh
